prompts.turned: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE documentary-style matched photographic diptych, two equally sized vertical frames side by side on a quiet pale grey background. Fixed camera, identical scale, matching flat front-facing transparent rectangular seed observation containers upright on the same tabletop. Moist white tissue supports ONE young mung bean seedling against the front wall; no soil, no standing water. One small natural support strip holds only the seed/cotyledon region, does not crush root or shoot. Left frame: immediately after the seedling itself is gently placed sideways once, its creamy slender existing root extends horizontally LEFT from a pair of small pale green cotyledons at centre, its slender green shoot with two small opposite oval first true leaves extends horizontally RIGHT. Right frame: the SAME identifiable seedling and matching original root/leaf shapes, same container position and same cotyledon anchor location; several days of new tip growth have occurred. The old central axis remains sideways, the ROOT's new white growing end curves visibly DOWNWARD from its left-hand end, and the SHOOT's new green tip curves clearly UPWARD from its right-hand end, carrying a small additional developing leaf. Preserve all starting structures rather than rotating the whole organism. Modest credible growth lengths, living turgid tissues, fine root hairs, accurate botanical anatomy. Both images from exactly the same camera angle and background, even indirect daylight. No text, date claims, arrows or drawn overlays; these are added later. No fantasy roots, cotton-like roots, cartoon geometry, lab props, glamorous lighting, or exaggerated plant size. This will be identified as a generated explanatory comparison, not a time-lapse or performed experiment.

The cotyledon surfaces have subtle natural granular texture and irregular curvature, seed coat extremely thin, not a hard thick shell. The right cotyledon is a separate corresponding lobe with no second embryo axis. Show all structures unobscured with space for labels to be added later. Accurate observed botanical form, refined and quiet, no cartoon outline, no thick lines, no symbols, no text, no arrows, no gloss or synthetic symmetry.
